Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Travel Guidance for Aurelia Skyways

We regret any confusion that may arise during pet travel arrangements, and this guide is intended to make the process clearer for travelers and crew alike. Aurelia Skyways asks that each companion animal be prepared with care before arrival at the skyport, since orderly handling supports comfort and safety for all involved.

Before travel, please review the carrier, document, and feeding guidance issued for the journey. Lucia Davis and Rafael Torres should expect the check-in review to focus on the condition of the animal, the fit of the carrier, and the completeness of the travel papers. Travelers are also asked to keep food and water access practical, clean, and suitable for the trip.

The companion animal area is designed to reduce stress, but good preparation remains essential. <<FACT F006>> Please follow the same respectful handling standards at every stage, because calm movement and clear communication help crews serve pets without avoidable delay.

At acceptance, staff will verify that the animal is ready for transit and that the carrier is secure. <<FACT F012>> If a concern appears during review, the crew may request a correction before the animal continues through the process.

For the best outcome, arrive with the animal settled, the carrier labeled as instructed, and the documents kept within easy reach. This article is intended to support safe travel, but the final decision always rests with the operating crew and the Companion Animal Travel Desk. For further assistance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly.
